titulo: How the digital Zona Azul works in Salvador
introducao: Zona Azul is a rotating parking system. It organizes spaces in regulated areas so more people can park through the day.
When you park in a signed space, check the rule posted there and activate with ZAS or another officially available option.

destaque.titulo: Buying credit in the app is not the same as activating parking
paragrafos: Buying credit adds balance you can use later. Activation registers parking for a specific license plate, rule, and period.
Having a balance in the app does not, by itself, mean the vehicle is in compliance. After you park, finish the activation and check the confirmation.

trechos.paragrafo: Enforcement uses the vehicle's license plate. You do not need to leave a receipt on the dashboard when the digital activation is registered correctly.
Every parking activation receives an authentication number. That number stays in the app's history and is your parking receipt with Transalvador.
With ZAS, if you move the vehicle within the first 15 minutes of activation, the credit can be returned and used later.

secoes.titulo: Older adults and people with disabilities or reduced mobility

trechos.paragrafo: Besides activating parking, you must keep the credential card issued by Transalvador on the vehicle's dashboard.
Before you park in a reserved space:

lista: make sure you have the required credential
check that the credential is still valid
leave it visible on the dashboard
complete the matching activation, when it is required

trechos.paragrafo: You can also activate parking with Zona Azul attendants from the Union of Parking Attendants and Car Washers of the State of Bahia (Sindguarda). They wear a uniform at the parking spots. With the attendants, you can buy credit by credit card, debit card, or cash.
